Question
========
What is the primary purpose of the YAML header at the top of a Quarto document?

Answerlist
----------
* To write the narrative text that appears in the rendered document.
* To define metadata and rendering options, such as the title and output format.
* To execute the document's R code.
* To list the keyboard shortcuts available in RStudio.

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Wrong: narrative text belongs in the Markdown body, not the YAML header.
* Correct: the YAML header configures metadata (title, author) and rendering options (output format, table of contents, etc.).
* Wrong: R code is executed in code chunks in the document body, not in the YAML header.
* Wrong: the YAML header has nothing to do with RStudio keyboard shortcuts.
